blind.description: A classic wooden china cabinet or display hutch in a stylized hand-painted finish. The upper section features twin glass-paned doors beneath a curved decorative crown pediment, with visible brass-toned hinges. The lower base contains a two-door storage cupboard with twin round brass knobs, resting on four short carved feet. Surfaces are smooth and continuous with clean geometry.
blind.from_above: A reddish-brown rectangular top surface bordered by a raised front decorative pediment and side ridge trims.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches roughly to the figure's neck, about 5 ft 0 in tall, and about 2.8 ft wide.
